title: Structs
explain: A struct groups named fields into one type. Create values with a literal, read fields with a dot, and pass a pointer when a function needs to change the original. Go has no classes, so structs plus methods are how you model data.
exercise: Define a `Rectangle` struct with width and height, and write a function that returns its area.
tip: Passing a struct by value copies it. Use a pointer like `*User` when the function must change the caller's struct.
